title: A field aligned under bddo:structOrigin counts from its struct's start; the origin is not inherited
description: Rec starts at offset 3. b is aligned to 2 from Rec's first byte, so after a it starts at offset 5 (Rec offset 2), not 4. c states no origin and aligns to 4 from the stream's start, offset 8, although its struct's b chose bddo:structOrigin.
